headline.purpose: Student list and form page headings.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Jade action for adding or saving a student.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:8px; padding:0 17px; background:#168866; color:#fff; font:700 15px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease,transform .15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:#116e54; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(16,185,129,.32); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:42px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; border:1px solid #cfd4dc; border-radius:8px; padding:0 17px; background:#fff; color:#28324a; font:700 15px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#f8fafb; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(16,185,129,.32); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Ruled white field used by login and student forms.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:44px; border:1px solid #bcc3ce; border-radius:7px; padding:9px 12px; background:#fff; color:#182139; font:400 15px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#929cab; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#3730a3; outline:3px solid rgba(55,48,163,.12); outline-offset:0; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#7b8497; }

components.name: Utility Navigation
components.description: Indigo header anchoring the authenticated student surface.
components.css: .ds-nav { height:64px; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:32px; padding:0 32px; border-bottom:3px solid #19a77b; background:#242261; color:#fff; font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { font-size:22px; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-nav a { color:#fff; font-size:14px; font-weight:650; text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline:3px solid rgba(16,185,129,.32); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Student Status
components.description: Quiet label communicating whether a student is active.
components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; border-radius:999px; padding:4px 9px; background:#dcf5eb; color:#11664e; font:750 12px ui-sans-serif,system-ui,'Segoe UI',sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Classora presents a cool mineral-white workspace with deep indigo ink and a single jade operational accent. It is compact, direct, and workmanlike: the roster is the product surface, while thin rules, clear labels, and exact Vietnamese status language provide structure instead of decorative SaaS chrome.

The Login and Student-management surfaces use scale and alignment for hierarchy. Forms read as carefully ruled enrollment sheets; the register stays flat and wide on desktop and becomes a set of bordered record blocks on narrow screens. Motion is limited to a brief content settle and respects reduced-motion preferences.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mineral-white workspace and deep indigo anchors
Jade reserved for operational actions and active status
Ruled, flat information surfaces with compact density
Native system workhorse sans with strong weight contrast

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Jade is the operational signal: use it for primary actions and active status, not as decoration across the screen.

rules.name: The Scale-First Rule
rules.body: Establish hierarchy through size, weight, and indigo ink; do not add ornamental display treatments.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: Let rules, tonal surfaces, and density define structure; do not lift ordinary data into floating cards.

dos: Do keep Vietnamese labels and status language precise and action-oriented.
Do use jade for a real operation or active state, with indigo as the structural anchor.
Do preserve the ruled register treatment for student data instead of wrapping it in decorative cards.
Do keep keyboard focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add dashboard statistics, speculative features, or decorative SaaS chrome to these surfaces.
Don't use shadows to manufacture hierarchy in the flat register language.
Don't canonize task-local composition as a reusable template; extend the visual rules, not the exact page arrangement.
